dataset_title: Okapi Wildlife Reserve monthly gross greenhouse-gas emissions data status

spatial_scope.name: Okapi Wildlife Reserve
spatial_scope.geometry_applied: Reserve polygon; no external buffer included

interpretation: The three requested reserve-wide gross-emission fields remain unknown, not zero. An assessment of the open CAMS GFAS 2026 fire-emissions product identified a potential experimental source for fire-only estimates, but its data could not be retrieved in this environment because CDS/ADS account authentication and manual acceptance of dataset terms are required. Even if retrieved, GFAS fire emissions alone would not represent total gross reserve emissions from all sources.

gross_emissions_co2e_all_gases__Mg.definition: Gross emissions from all included greenhouse gases, expressed as carbon-dioxide equivalent for the specified month and reserve polygon. Null means not quantifiable from evidence reviewed; it is not zero.

gross_emissions_co2e_non_co2__Mg.definition: Gross non-CO2 emissions (for example CH4 and N2O, if included by the documented inventory boundary) expressed as CO2e. Null means not quantifiable; no RFO-specific gas flux/activity data and factors were available.

gross_emissions_co2e_co2_only__Mg.definition: Gross CO2 emissions only for the specified month and reserve polygon. Null means not quantifiable; MODIS burned-area screening does not establish combustion emissions or associated carbon-stock loss.

data_status.definition: The reporting month was assessed but no defensible gross-emissions amount can be calculated from the data reviewed.

satellite_observation_columns.definition: Contextual scene counts, Sentinel-2 vegetation indices, and separate NASA MODIS photosynthesis and burned-area screening. Sentinel-2 indices are not carbon flux; photosynthesis is modelled uptake and burned area is not emissions.

modis_burned_area_ha.definition: QA-screened MCD64A1.061 500 m burned-pixel area. Zero means no eligible product pixels were detected, not proof of no fire or zero emissions; unavailable months remain null.

modis_burned_area_valid_coverage_pct.definition: QA-valid land pixels as a share of RFO pixel centers in the monthly MCD64A1 image.

modis_burned_pixel_count.definition: Number of MCD64A1 burned pixels with valid land/data quality bits inside the RFO.

modis_burned_area_status.definition: MCD64A1 image processing/availability status; NOT_PUBLISHED_IN_CATALOG_AS_OF_2026-11-04 means missing, not zero.

satellite_carbon_assessment.product_description: 500 m cumulative eight-day estimates of gross primary productivity (GPP) and net photosynthesis (PSN); PSN is GPP minus maintenance respiration.
satellite_carbon_assessment.units: Mg C per RFO and observed reporting period
satellite_carbon_assessment.scale_factor: 0.0001 kg C m-2 per eight-day composite; multiplied by equal-area pixel area and converted from kg to Mg
satellite_carbon_assessment.spatial_method: The RFO polygon is projected to the MODIS sinusoidal equal-area grid. Pixel centers inside the polygon are retained. Data values outside their documented valid ranges and pixels without MODLAND-QC-good status are excluded.
satellite_carbon_assessment.monthly_method: Each cumulative eight-day composite is proportionally assigned to calendar months by the number of overlapping days, assuming a uniform daily rate within that composite. Reported area-expanded values scale each composite's valid-pixel sum by the inverse of its valid-area fraction.
satellite_carbon_assessment.coverage: Full calendar-date coverage is available for January-September. The latest RFO-intersecting Terra composite covers 2026-10-08 through 2026-10-15, so October has 15/31 observed days. Valid-area coverage over observed dates ranges from 28.248% to 99.796%; October's combined date-and-valid-area coverage is 27.786% of the full month.
satellite_carbon_assessment.quality_and_uncertainty: The area expansion assumes MODLAND-QC-good pixels represent the full reserve for each composite. It is a simple spatial extrapolation, not a validated gap-filling model; low-coverage months are especially uncertain. The output also preserves unexpanded valid-pixel sums and coverage percentages.
satellite_carbon_assessment.interpretation: GPP and PSN are modelled photosynthetic carbon-uptake indicators. They do not measure reserve carbon stocks, net ecosystem sequestration, net ecosystem exchange, carbon-dioxide-equivalent removals, or greenhouse-gas emissions. Do not use them to populate the gross-emissions, biomass-stock, gross-sequestration, or net-balance fields.

satellite_burned_area_assessment.product_description: Terra+Aqua monthly global 500 m burned-area product with Burn_Date and QA bands.
satellite_burned_area_assessment.spatial_method: The RFO polygon is projected to the MODIS sinusoidal equal-area grid. Pixel centers inside the reserve are retained. Burn_Date and QA COGs are clipped and stored as two-band GeoTIFFs.
satellite_burned_area_assessment.quality_method: A burned pixel must have Burn_Date 1-366 and both QA bit 0 (land) and bit 1 (valid observation) set. Area is the count of such pixels multiplied by the equal-area grid-cell area; no spatial extrapolation is applied.
satellite_burned_area_assessment.results: No QA-valid burned pixels were detected within the RFO for January-August 2026, with 99.991-99.992% valid land-pixel coverage. September and October were absent from the queried STAC catalog and are blank, not zero.
satellite_burned_area_assessment.interpretation: A coarse satellite burned-area screening result only. Zero detected pixels do not prove the absence of all fire, particularly small, obscured, under-canopy, or low-intensity fire. Burned area alone cannot quantify affected biomass, combustion, carbon-pool loss, or emissions.

open_data_assessment.candidate_dataset: CAMS global biomass burning emissions based on fire radiative power (GFAS)
open_data_assessment.temporal_coverage: Hourly estimates and daily averages from 2026-01-01 to present; Jan-Oct 2026 falls within the advertised coverage.
open_data_assessment.method: Satellite fire-radiative-power assimilation converted to dry matter burned, then gas emissions using biome-specific emission factors. This is a model estimate for biomass-burning fires, not a direct ground measurement.
open_data_assessment.retrieval_limitations: The official CDS API instructions require a user account, personal access token, and manual acceptance of dataset terms before retrieval. No CDS API token was configured in this environment. No monthly reserve-intersected GFAS data were downloaded or calculated.
open_data_assessment.potential_calculation_if_retrieved: Integrate daily GFAS fluxes (kg m-2 s-1) by time and geodesic area of each 0.1-degree cell's intersection with the RFO polygon, converting kg to Mg. Report modeled fire-only CO2 mass separately; calculate non-CO2 CO2e from CH4 and N2O with a declared IPCC GWP assessment and time horizon; define fire-only all-gases as CO2-only plus those included non-CO2 components. Preserve grid-cell coverage and model uncertainty.
open_data_assessment.scope_caveat: GFAS covers fire-related emissions only. It cannot alone quantify the requested all-source gross emissions from non-fire deforestation/degradation, logging, mining, agriculture, fuel use, ecosystem fluxes, or other sources. GFAS's 0.1-degree grid is also coarse relative to reserve boundaries.

other_open_data_reviewed.review_result: Public monthly Burn_Date and QA Cloud-Optimized GeoTIFFs for January-August 2026 were retrieved, clipped to RFO, and processed. No QA-valid burned pixels were detected; the catalog query returned no September-October RFO products by 2026-11-04. See data/processed/OWR_MODIS_Burned_Area_2026.csv and the clipped raster archive. Burn area is not emissions.

Public 500 m eight-day GPP and net-photosynthesis COG assets were retrieved and summarized over the RFO. Monthly estimates and spatial/time coverage are in data/processed/OWR_MODIS_Carbon_2026.csv. The products are modelled uptake indicators, not stock, net ecosystem sequestration, or emissions; October data end on October 15.

other_open_data_reviewed.source: NASA FIRMS VIIRS/MODIS active fire products
other_open_data_reviewed.review_result: The Area API requires a free FIRMS MAP_KEY. No key was configured, so no RFO Jan-Oct 2026 detections were retrieved. Active-fire detections indicate thermal anomalies, not burned area or emitted mass.
The catalog reports coverage ending 2020-12; it cannot provide observed 2026 burned area.
The annual loss-year band covers 2001-2025; it cannot provide 2026 forest-loss observations.
The repository's earlier API check found that a valid API key is required; no boundary-level monthly alert counts were obtained. Alerts are not direct carbon-flux estimates.

calculation_method.current: No reserve-wide gross-emissions values or GFAS fire-only values were calculated. MCD64A1 provides a burned-area screening result of zero QA-valid burned pixels for January-August; September-October products were not in the queried catalog. These data do not determine fire emissions or other carbon losses. Requested gross-emissions fields remain null rather than being inferred from burned area, vegetation indices, or modeled photosynthesis.
calculation_method.experimental_fire_only_candidate: If GFAS 1.4.2 is retrieved, it can support an explicitly labeled, coarse-resolution modeled fire-only estimate, not the complete reserve gross-emissions fields. The requested total fields must remain null unless a full-source accounting boundary is supported.
required_for_quantification: Retrieve and archive the requested CAMS GFAS dates through authenticated CDS/ADS access after accepting the dataset terms; retain product version and coverage metadata.
Validate monthly disturbed/burned/conversion area against optical and radar time series and reference data.
Determine affected land-use/pool transitions and pre-disturbance carbon stocks with appropriate biomass/soil datasets and field or validated model support.
Apply DRC- and ecosystem-appropriate emission factors with explicit carbon pools, combustion/decay, and uncertainty.
Quantify CH4 and N2O where applicable using activity data and appropriate factors; convert gases to CO2e using an explicitly cited IPCC assessment basis and time horizon.
Document gross accounting boundary; prevent double-counting between CO2-only and non-CO2 components; reconcile all-gases total.

citation: NASA CMR, NASA Terra MODIS MOD17A2H.061, NASA/USGS MODIS MCD64A1.061, Microsoft Planetary Computer STAC, CAMS GFAS, NASA FIRMS, ESA CCI FireCCI, Hansen/UMD Global Forest Change, and Global Forest Watch catalog/API documentation; see source-specific retrieval status and limitations. Catalog coverage and model availability are not evidence of retrieved RFO values.

spatial_satellite_layer.interpretation: Relative October NDVI screening zones only. These are not validated ecological, degradation, biomass, or emissions classes.
